title: Singularity Probability of Random Symmetric Sign Matrices
exact_target: Let $Q_n$ be an $n\times n$ random symmetric matrix whose upper-triangular entries are independent Bernoulli variables taking values $\pm1$. Determine or estimate the probability that $Q_n$ is singular.
